body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Anybots(www.anybots.com) presented its telepresence robot 'QA' at the CES 2009.

The QA operates simply, cleanly, and quietly while still giving you a full physical presence. It allows you to see and be seen, talk and listen, and collaborate in ways and places never before possible.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
